LST 250: LST 250 is a research-based class that prepares students to critically think about, use, and produce information.
LST 490: Introduction to the principles and procedures in the management of archives and historical manuscripts.
LST 495: Directed internship in library studies, archival administration, rare books curation and/or preservation.
LST 496: Creative projects, including research and design, which are supervised on an individual basis and which fall outside the scope of formal courses.
